info.title: HuisHype API
info.description: Social real estate platform API - Browse properties, submit price guesses, and engage with the community

get.description: Returns the health status of the API server

post.description: Validate Google ID token, create or find user, return JWT tokens
Validate Apple ID token, create or find user, return JWT tokens
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token
Invalidate refresh token (client should also clear tokens)

get.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user

anyOf.description: Geometry used for imagery framing. May snap to a nearby building surface point.
Geometry used for imagery framing. May snap to a nearby building surface point.

get.summary: Find nearby grouped property in Following mode
get.description: Returns the personalized grouped-property hit for the signed-in viewer when Following is active.

get.summary: Get price guesses for a property
get.description: Get all price guesses submitted for a specific property, with statistics

post.description: Submit or update a price guess for a property.

get.description: Get paginated comments for a property with replies (1 level deep). Sorting options: recent (newest first) or popular (most liked first).

post.description: Add a comment to a property. Set parentId to reply to another comment (1 level deep only).

get.description: Get the like status and count for a comment. Returns liked=false if not authenticated.

post.description: Add a like reaction to a comment. Returns 409 if already liked.

delete.description: Remove a like reaction from a comment. Returns 404 if not previously liked.

post.description: Add a like reaction to a property. Returns 409 if already liked.

delete.description: Remove a like reaction from a property. Returns 404 if not previously liked.

get.summary: Get glyph PBF range for a font
get.description: Returns a PBF file containing glyphs for the requested font and Unicode range.
Returns a sprite JSON manifest or PNG atlas.

get.summary: Get merged map style with property layers
get.description: Returns MapLibre style JSON with base map + property vector tiles.
Returns TileJSON 2.1.0 metadata for property vector tiles.
Returns TileJSON 2.1.0 metadata for authenticated Following property vector tiles.
Returns private TileJSON metadata for viewer-specific read-state property overlay tiles.
Returns MVT/PBF vector tile with density-aware grouped property data. Active nodes may group at any zoom, while ghost nodes reveal at Z17+ on a separate grouping path.
Returns private MVT/PBF overlay tiles containing only grouped property nodes that are read for the current viewer.
Returns personalized MVT/PBF property tiles grouped from followed-user qualifying activity for the signed-in viewer.
Returns MVT with deterministically scattered tree points inside landcover polygons.
Returns MVT with individual OSM building footprints and heights.
Returns all listings for a property, ordered by creation date descending

get.summary: Get price history for a property
get.description: Returns all price history events for a property, ordered by date descending

post.description: Validates a listing URL against source services and enriches display metadata from caller input or Open Graph fallback.
Creates a listing from a validated preview token. Requires authentication.
Internal endpoint for mirror sync workers. Requires API key authentication.

get.description: Returns the durable ingest cursor for a given source. Used by sync workers to resume without skipping rows.

post.description: Record a view for a property. Authenticated or anonymous. Deduplicates: same user/session only counts once per hour.

get.summary: List followers for the current user
List followed users for the current user

get.description: Get a paginated feed of properties with active listings. Filters: trending (weighted 7-day activity) and latest (most recent activity).
Proxies to Photon geocoder and returns formatted address suggestions.
Reverse geocodes a coordinate to a location hierarchy via Photon. Returns { locality, district, county, city, state, country, countryCode } or null if nothing found.

get.summary: Get notifications for the current user

put.summary: Mark a single notification as read

post.summary: Register a push notification token for a device

get.description: Rankings by karma (all-time) or by recent engagement activity (week/month). If authenticated, includes the current user's rank.

anyOf.description: Geometry used for imagery framing. May snap to a nearby building surface point.

get.description: Returns newest-first ungrouped activity items. `scope=public` is public, while `scope=following` requires authentication and only includes activity from followed users.
Returns newest-first property activity posts grouped by property. `scope=public` is public, while `scope=following` requires authentication and only includes activity from followed users.
Returns newest-first ungrouped activity items for the signed-in user. This is the only activity route that includes private save events.

get.summary: Get all achievements with unlock state
get.description: Returns earned and available achievements for the current user.
Returns all available achievement definitions without user state.

get.summary: Preview the email magic link template
get.description: Renders the current magic link email template in a browser preview. Available only in development and test environments.

post.description: Generates a magic link token for the given email. In production, delivers via email. In dev mode, returns the token in the response.
Validates the token, creates or finds the user, returns a session.
